status_rule: A journey becomes passed only when every required assertion axis is evidenced on one exact candidate SHA.

journeys.title: First store onboarding
backend_assertions: draft edits have no Shopify side effect
credential identity, served API version and scopes are verified
workflow authority, defaults and location mappings persist by semantic step_key
activation is admitted only from current grouped readiness
remote_assertions: read-only identity/scope/location calls only
truthful active store identity

journeys.title: Additional stores and companies
backend_assertions: credentials, settings, mappings, bindings, checkpoints and runs remain store scoped
active-company and exact-store checks apply to records, counts, suggestions and commands
retired and disconnected stores remain distinguishable
remote_assertions: each call uses the selected store identity and credential generation

journeys.title: Product import, matching and refresh
backend_assertions: pagination and checkpoint overlap are bounded
remote GID binding wins and names never auto-match
ambiguous deterministic keys route to review
refresh and deleted-remote state preserve protected Odoo fields
remote_assertions: product and variant reads only
missed event repair creates no duplicate binding

journeys.title: Product publication and update
backend_assertions: link, first publication and continuous update are distinct intents
field authority and diff fingerprint are explicit
stale preview cannot mutate
canonical product/variant/media bindings are unique
remote_assertions: typed mutation plan
canonical GID readback
no duplicate after uncertain send

journeys.title: Customer and order intake
backend_assertions: customer and order bindings remain exactly once per store
tax, discount, shipping, tip, currency, line and total evidence is retained
manual gateway and commercial ambiguity are reviewed
cancelled, voided or expired Shopify state blocks unsafe fulfillment without rewriting completed Odoo work
remote_assertions: order/customer reads only
overlap import yields one Odoo intent

journeys.title: Inventory first push and continuous sync
backend_assertions: location mapping is exact and store scoped
first push requires observations, preview, fingerprint and Administrator confirmation
rapid stock changes coalesce without blind overwrite
mapping, quantity or warehouse-tree drift invalidates stale authority
remote_assertions: inventory item/location readback
one effective quantity mutation per safe scope

journeys.title: Fulfillment and tracking
backend_assertions: eligible FulfillmentOrder, location and lines are selected
full/partial intent and effective customer notification are explicit
fulfillment and picking binding is unique
tracking update and no-op are distinguishable
remote_assertions: fulfillment/tracking mutation readback
no duplicate shipment or notification

journeys.title: Trigger and recovery parity
backend_assertions: all triggers admit the same typed domain intent
priority, duplicate suppression and evidence semantics are shared
duplicate, delayed, out-of-order and missed webhooks converge through reconciliation
remote_assertions: one business effect independent of trigger path

journeys.title: Failure, retry and uncertain mutation recovery
backend_assertions: clean pre-send failure and possible after-send effect are different states
bounded retry is allowed only when absence is certain
readback resolves applied/not-applied/inconclusive without blind replay
manual evidence is required at the uncertainty cap
remote_assertions: fake ledger proves zero duplicate remote effect

journeys.title: Daily operations and Needs Attention
backend_assertions: highest-impact issue is ranked and scoped truthfully
allowed action is server-authorized and state-version checked
terminal state updates overview, freshness and affected record evidence
remote_assertions: no UI action creates an unapproved mutation
failure_branches: uncertain mutation has no retry action

journeys.title: Connection and store lifecycle
backend_assertions: credential replacement and scope/version drift increment the correct generation fence
pause/disconnect settles or verifies queued and in-flight work
reconnect preserves identity lineage and retire preserves bindings/history
unsafe domain/company retargeting is rejected
remote_assertions: connector-owned subscription state is read back
custom-app token revocation remains an explicit merchant action when Shopify cannot be revoked by the connector

journeys.title: Roles, companies and direct access
backend_assertions: model, facade and button authorization use one capability contract
active company and exact store apply to records, counts, empty states and suggestions
credentials and protected PII never enter a response
remote_assertions: unauthorized calls have zero transport or mutation effect

journeys.title: Install, upgrade, restart and rollback
backend_assertions: supported addon combinations install in dependency order
V1 record IDs, bindings, jobs, logs and mutation evidence survive warm upgrade
backfill resumes idempotently and restart quarantines uncertain work
backup/restore identity samples and constraints match
lowering store modes does not duplicate remote effects
remote_assertions: rollback and restart create no new remote mutation

journeys.title: Complete merchant loops
backend_assertions: Shopify product/order becomes the intended Odoo product/customer/order/inventory/picking evidence
Odoo product publication and stock update read back before the storefront order returns through the first path
two stores in one company remain isolated throughout
one after-send uncertainty terminates safely as verified or manual-review without duplicate effect
remote_assertions: canonical cross-domain readback for product, inventory, order and fulfillment
fake/live ledger contains no duplicate mutation
